description:
Check what EU law says for a product type matching the facts given: whether it needs a Digital Product Passport, from when, at which level, under which act and article, and the duties of each role. Also read the company's catalogue-wide scope report and trigger a catalogue refresh run.

HARD RULES — always apply these to scope answers:
- Answers state what the law says for product types matching the given facts. This is not legal advice; never write 'you must' — use product-type phrasing ('LMT batteries need a passport from 18 February 2027, Battery Regulation Art. 77(1)').
- Cite the article the answer gives for every verdict and duty. A regulation without an article is not a citation. A `not_covered` answer rests on no article: say our rules do not cover the product and name the nearest act it gives, never cite that act as the basis.
- A date with precision 'quarter', 'month' or 'year' is a plan, NEVER a deadline or a start date. Write 'planned for Q2 2027 (planned, not law yet)', never 'from', 'by' or 'deadline'.
- Relay `not_covered` and `needs_input` as the results they are, never as errors. `not_covered` = the product falls outside these scope rules. `needs_input` = blocking questions remain unanswered — relay the questions in `ask[]` to the user before giving a verdict.
- Items in an act's `planned` list are not law yet: always label them 'Planned, not law yet' (`labelText`), with their `wording`.
- `ruleStatus: 'needs_recheck'` means the law behind an act changed and our rules for it are being re-checked (since `recheckSince`): say so with the answer.

Actions (pass via `action`, with `args`):
- check — args: { category?, facts?, role?, placedOnMarket?, lifecycleEvent?, contains?, productId?, passportId?, locale? }. Ask whether a product type needs a DPP. Available on every plan, Free included. Counts against the per-company scope-answer cap (~100/day, 30/min burst), NOT the v1 read/write budget. 429 `scope_answer_cap` when the daily cap is spent. `not_covered` and `needs_input` are 200 results, not errors.
  category: one of battery | detergents | toys | construction | textile | steel | tyres | furniture | electronics | packaging | paints-coatings | jewelry | fmcg | vehicles | other.
  facts: namespace-prefixed keys from the loaded rules (e.g. battery.use, battery.capacityKWh). Unknown keys or wrong values return 400 invalid_input.
  role: your role in the act's terms: manufacturer | importer | distributor | authorised_representative | fulfilment_service_provider. Selling under your own name = manufacturer with facts.ownBrand: true. Omit to list every role's duties.
  placedOnMarket: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD' | 'YYYY-MM' | 'YYYY', precision?: 'day'|'month'|'year' } or null.
  contains: array (≤5) of component queries — use to ask about a battery inside a toy: [ { label?, facts? } ].
  locale: en | bg | de | it (default: from Accept-Language header, else en).
- catalogue_report — args: { classification?, category?, act?, changed?, q?, cursor?, limit? (≤500) }. Read the catalogue-wide scope report (one row per product). Requires the Growth plan or above; 403 `plan_upgrade_required` below Growth — tell the user this needs a plan upgrade, do not retry. Counts 1 against the daily read budget per page.
  classification filter: missing | draft_only | published_incomplete | published | not_required | open_questions | not_covered.
  Response: { run, running, totals, items: [{ productId, passportIds, gtin, category, summary, classification, changedAt }], nextCursor, disclaimer }. Full answer for one product: call check with that productId.
- catalogue_run — args: {}. Start a catalogue scope refresh run (also runs nightly). Returns 202 { runId, status }; poll with catalogue_run_status. Requires Growth plan. 409 run_in_progress if already active; 429 run_cooldown with retryAfter within 10 minutes of a finished run.
- catalogue_run_status — args: { runId }. Get the status (queued | running | done | failed) and result counts for one catalogue run. Requires Growth plan.

action.description: Which scope operation to run: check | catalogue_report | catalogue_run | catalogue_run_status.

args.description: Arguments for the chosen action; required fields depend on `action` (see above).

act.description: Filter catalogue_report by governing act (CELEX, e.g. 32023R1542).

category.description: Product category for check (battery, textile, vehicles, other, …).

changed.description: catalogue_report: true to return only rows changed since the last run.

classification.description: Filter catalogue_report by classification: missing | draft_only | published_incomplete | published | not_required | open_questions | not_covered.

contains.description: Component queries for check (max 5), e.g. a toy containing a battery.

locale.description: Answer locale for check: en | bg | de | it.

passportId.description: Passport id — adds saved passport facts to check.

placedOnMarket.description: Placing date for check: { date: YYYY[-MM[-DD]], precision?: day|month|year } or null.

productId.description: Product id — adds saved product facts and passport data to check.

q.description: catalogue_report: search by product name or GTIN.

role.description: Role hint for check (e.g. manufacturer, importer, ownBrand).

name: tracepass_scope

error.description: Machine-readable error code, when the API rejected the request.

id.description: The resource's TracePass id, when the response is a single entity.

items.description: The page of results, when the action is a list.

message.description: Human-readable error or status detail, when present.

result.description: Wraps a non-object response body (e.g. a QR code string).

total.description: Total matching records across all pages (list actions).

title: TracePass DPP scope checker
